queries:
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city AS town,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_avg AS (
  SELECT town,
         AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town_avg
)
SELECT t.town,
       t.avg_price,
       t.avg_ratio,
       t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM town_avg t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id,
         c.town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town_stats AS (
  SELECT town_city,
         AVG(avg_price) AS town_avg_price,
         AVG(avg_ratio) AS town_avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio
  FROM item_town
)
SELECT t.town_city,
       t.town_avg_price,
       t.town_avg_ratio,
       t.town_avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM town_stats t
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.town_avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;
WITH item AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town AS (
  SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost) AS overall_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
)
SELECT t.town_city, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_excess
FROM town t, overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio
